Because creation isn’t about validation. 

It’s about execution. 

It’s about taking that idea in your head and making it real.

To make sure that when you just create, the world takes notice. 

And you get what you deserve for doing it.

No gatekeepers. No waiting. No limits.

JUST CREATE.
